title: Sales Data Analysis
description: Analyze quarterly sales data and provide insights
prompt:
Given the following quarterly sales data:
Q1 2023: $450,000
Q2 2023: $520,000
Q3 2023: $485,000
Q4 2023: $610,000
Q1 2024: $580,000

Provide:
1. Year-over-year growth rate for Q1
2. The quarter with highest growth
3. Average quarterly sales for 2023
4. Brief recommendation for Q2 2024 sales target
